contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #029: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base.
Audit the primary prop:reflection for fixed cyclotomic F containing mu_12, the final fixed S, and exactly the coefficient family and generator conventions in the staged October 4, 2026 sources.

definitions.q: absolute norm of an exterior ideal, equal to the S-norm of an allowed generator
definitions.mask: all residue-character powers are zero on nonunits, including exponent zero
definitions.Gamma: U_S^6; E and B are the declared complementary isotropic sixth-power classes
definitions.h_d: the powerful part and valuation-one squarefree part of the row ideal

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 029 (Primitive roots for every admissible integer base.; papers: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base; Simultaneous primitive roots: a conditional lower bound for prime bases; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
Settle whether the declared cover, Whittaker normalization, reflected expansion, and quadratic sieve justify prop:reflection, by a source-faithful obstruction or an all-parameter proof.
For every integer a other than -1 or an integer square, at least c_a x/(log x)^2 primes in every sufficiently large (x,2x) have ord_p(a)=p-1.
For the stated fixed progression data M,c,u, there are many primes p=crQ+1 with Q>x^0.9 and all prime factors of r between exp((log x)^0.1) and exp((log x)^0.3).
For fixed |a|>1 and the stated growing primes q, the number of primes in (x,2x] splitting completely in Q(mu_q,a^(1/q)) is O_a(x/(q(q-1)log x)+x^(1-10^-6)).
For every cyclotomic F containing mu_12 and every finite-order Hecke character eta, L_F(s,eta) has no zeros in Re(s)>1-10^-6, without a conductor or height cutoff.
For all epsilon>0, Z>=2 and dyadic P,D>=1, the B_m(Z) squared mass on the specified compact balanced annular rows is O(Z^epsilon P^(1/2)(D+D^2P/Z)).

The fixed S-integer generator convention has E direct-sum B power classes, exact exterior sextic reciprocity, the declared Gauss correction characters, and the zero extension on every nonunit including zeroth powers.

The stated c=2 cubic cover and exceptional datum give a genuine automorphic theta representation with the exact lifts, local spherical values, local uniqueness and complex behavior declared in prop:theta-input.

The determinant-modified c=2 threefold GL_2 cover descends through the ordinary split scalar subgroup, with the specified exceptional central character and compatible root, torus, compact and rational lifts.
At every exterior prime, W(a(p^(3k)))=q^-k, W(a(p^(3k+1)))=q^(-k-1/2)g_2, W(a(p^(3k+2)))=0, negative valuations vanish, and units contribute chi(u)^(2e).
The nonzero global Whittaker functional factors with normalized spherical exterior factors, consistently with the KP correction, and gives the stated rational Fourier expansion.
The finite torus cutoff and all fixed complex derivative/Weyl-rotated Whittaker functions satisfy the norm-sheet bounds used in reflection.
The common radial profile V admits the exact Gaussian averaging kernel with all absolute moments, with Mellin convention Khat(-s)=exp(s^2)/Vhat(s).
For all valuation classes j mod 6 and every numerator valuation, the Fourier masks and local Weyl calculation have the support and monomial exponents stated in lem:reflection-local-Weyl.

The full reflected expansion holds for every nonzero row, including independent unit classes, shared primes, powerful rows, unrestricted cubes, and active or inactive masked zeroth powers; its only unfrozen row-column pairing is quadratic.
The primitive quadratic Kummer characters attached to allowed squarefree exterior generators satisfy Goldmakher-Louvel Definition 1 and hence the (C+D)(CD)^epsilon quadratic large sieve.
The all-parameter tail, frozen-exponent, cube and powerful-ideal estimates turn the full reflected expansion and quadratic sieve into the claimed dyadic mass bound.
Poisson summation and the Euler-product calculation isolate the principal double residue with a holomorphic nonvanishing correction to 1/L^S(s,eta).
The primitive conductor sieve and zero detector control all nonprincipal Poisson frequencies with the saving used in the comparison.
The principal comparison integral has the stated power saving, and its shifted Mellin transform excludes zeros of the target L-function.

Conditional on the four explicitly stated inputs, every fixed finite list of distinct positive prime bases are simultaneously primitive roots at at least c_q x/(log x)^2 primes in every sufficiently large (x,2x).
Conditional on marked Type II, block sieve and rough density, the secondary fixed-progression reservoir contains many primes p=4rQ+1 with the stated factor ranges.
Conditional on the uniform Hecke zero-free input, the secondary order-obstruction count satisfies x/(ell(ell-1)log x)+x^(1-10^-6) for the stated controlled primes ell.
The secondary Input input:hecke assumes the primary conductor- and height-unrestricted zero-free assertion; it is a hypothesis, not a result proved by the secondary paper.
The marked Type II coefficient criterion and rough coefficient cancellation hold with their stated fixed-parameter, character, frequency and interval uniformities.
The block sieve has its stated uniform constants and unweighted squarefree remainder sum, including the H=2 upper bound.
The rough-number density satisfies the stated least-factor integral identity and exponentially accurate e^(-gamma_E)/b upper bound.

claims.natural_statement: For every prime power q congruent to 1 modulo 12, an order-six residue character chi with the manuscript additive convention, and the declared exceptional Jacquet model, the three shell classes give W_(3k)=q^(-k), W_(3k+1)=q^(-k-1)G_2 and W_(3k+2)=0 for every k>=0. Every masked exponent j modulo 6 has the stated local Weyl transform, with R(j,e+3,t)=q^(-1)R(j,e,t) for e>=1, the stated distinct e=0 formula, and unit exponent 1-4=3 giving the quadratic row-column pairing. The identities include zeroth-power masks and all unrestricted cube valuations; this is a supplied-data algebra theorem, not an unconditional analytic moment bound.
